title: A query function with two untyped parameters
query: DEFINE FUNCTION SumTwoNumbers = ( A, B ) => A + B

source.quote: The function definition includes the signature (the name and the parameters: A , B ) and the function body ( A + B ), separated by the => symbol.
source.supports: the article shows this query returning 30

notes: The article shows the value; the type follows from integer + integer.
